interface.name: termux_ahardware_buffer_manager_v1

description.summary: create wl_buffers backed by Android hardware buffers

interface.description:
This private protocol is available only in native Android/Bionic builds. Before issuing create_buffer, the client sends one AHardwareBuffer over the supplied AF_UNIX stream socket with AHardwareBuffer_sendHandleToUnixSocket.
Version 1 uses implicit synchronization. The producer must finish all GPU writes before attaching the returned wl_buffer. wl_buffer.release tells the producer when the compositor no longer reads the buffer.

entry.name: invalid_handle
entry.summary: the socket did not contain an AHardwareBuffer

entry.name: invalid_buffer
entry.summary: the AHardwareBuffer cannot be sampled by the compositor

entry.name: swap_red_blue
entry.summary: swap red and blue when sampling

entry.name: unknown
entry.summary: the probe could not be completed

entry.name: identity
entry.summary: red and blue are sampled without conversion

entry.name: swap_red_blue
entry.summary: red and blue are reversed when sampled

request.name: create_buffer

description.summary: import an AHardwareBuffer as a wl_buffer

request.description: The socket fd is consumed by the compositor. The imported buffer size, format, stride and usage are obtained from AHardwareBuffer_describe.

request.name: probe_buffer

description.summary: probe compositor sampling of a known-color buffer

request.description: The client must render opaque red into the supplied AHardwareBuffer and finish the GPU write before sending it. The compositor imports and samples the buffer through its real rendering context, then replies with probe_result carrying the same token.
